Meet the lab

An interdisciplinary team engineering human microvascular systems at UNC Charlotte.

Dr. Nan Zhao

Principal Investigator · Assistant Professor

Dr. Zhao leads the Microvascular Engineering & Regeneration Laboratory in the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Engineering Science. His research brings together human extracellular matrix biomaterials, tissue-engineered microvessels, and vascularized tissues.

His work includes models of brain angiogenesis and the blood–brain barrier, and he established the MER Lab at UNC Charlotte in 2025.
